scope: Source-only bounded review of 16 deterministic newly admitted Arabic Aya rows with at least 50 target tokens under the expanded tokenizer; no model outputs or final holdout inspected.
sample_method: Sort new Arabic Aya candidates absent from v2b train by SHA256('source-review-v3:' + id), take first 16 after existing v2b and original quality filters.
assessment: Six rows had no obvious issue in this limited reading. Ten are quarantined for defects, missing support, scope, or unverified specialized constraints. This is purposive source QA, not a factual accuracy estimate; remaining annotations are not comprehensively verified.

exclusions.reason: Arabic book titles visibly do not translate the paired English titles (Blind Watchmaker and God Delusion); do not repair labels silently.
